subject: Add dNdS informations stocked into dataframe in the tree plot

messages.author: bf3ba32b263963d3
messages.subject: Add dNdS informations stocked into dataframe in the tree plot
parts:
Hello I hope you are doing well in these particular times, I'm writing to you because I need help to add dN/dS information on some branches of my tree.

Here is my data table (also attached as: Resricted_df_heatmap2)


I also have a phylogenetic tree (attached under the name: Phylo_tree.nwk ) which corresponds to the same leaf names as the Seq_name column.




From this dataframe I can generate a figure such as:






Resricted_df_heatmap2<-read.table("Resricted_df_heatmap2.txt",sep="\t",header=T)
rownames(Resricted_df_heatmap2) <-Resricted_df_heatmap2$Seq_name
Resricted_df_heatmap2$Seq_name<-NULL
mod_mat<-data.matrix(Resricted_df_heatmap2)


mod_mat2=cut(mod_mat, c(0,0.05,1,11,111)) %>% matrix(ncol=ncol(mod_mat))

rownames(mod_mat2) <- rownames(Resricted_df_heatmap2)
colnames(mod_mat2) = colnames(Resricted_df_heatmap2)

tree = read.newick("Phylo_tree.nwk")


x <- c(rep(NA,length(tree$tip.label)), as.numeric(tree$node.label))
col <- cut(x, breaks=c(0,50,75,90,99,100))
col <- factor(col, levels=rev(levels(col)))
col <- factor(col, labels=c("100%","91-99%","76-90%","51-75%","0-50%"))


p1<- ggtree(tree, size=0.5,branch.length="none") +
  geom_tiplab(size = 5, col ="black", offset=1.5)  +
  geom_point(aes(color=col), alpha=1, size=1.5, show.legend = TRUE) +
  geom_treescale(x=30, y=1) +
  theme(legend.position=c(0.2,0.7)) +
  scale_colour_manual(na.translate = F, name="B \n\n Bootstrap support",
                      values=c("#CB1414","#F0F014","#098527","#18D8F7","#1B72DB")) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5)))



label_text <-  c("(0,0.05]","(0.05,1]","(1,11]","(11,111]")
gheatmap(p1,mod_mat2,offset=5,colnames_offset_y = 1, width=3,colnames_angle=-45,hjust=0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#d71f1f","#63bf07","#63bf07","#63bf07"), breaks=label_text)


Where I'm blocking is that I would now like to add the information from the Mean_dNdS & Pvalue_dNdS columns as on the concerned branches as such :



For example SP1 and SP2 have the same Mean_dNdS & Pvalue_dNdS values so I write on their common branch at the top the value of the Mean_dNdS column and at the bottom the value of the Pvalue_dNdS column.

Same for SP6,7,8,9 which also have the same values.

Do you have any idea if ggtree can do such a thing?

Thank you very muc.

messages.subject: Re: Add dNdS informations stocked into dataframe in the tree plot
parts:
for your first question, I think tidytree package can help. Of course you need to develop some scripts by yourself. There is no function directly address this issue.

For your second question, see https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/chapter7.html#gheatmap-ggnewscale

I was also wondering if there was an option to change the color and size of the separation between columns and rows?
